markdown: **Activate—Dimension Leap** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentration](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710)) **Frequency** once per day; Trigger You succeed at a saving throw against a spell from the chosen tradition;   **Effect** Your veil billows out and you disappear behind it. You use the traces of [dweomercat](/Monsters.aspx?ID=643) magic to teleport yourself instantly to any unoccupied square within 30 feet. If you critically succeeded at the triggering save, you can instead teleport within 45 feet.
